headline: Late and priced: Smurfit Westrock's miss and cut came before the open; the stock is already -5.4%
reasoning: Source: Smurfit Westrock's Q3 2026 results, summarized by Finanzen.ch and relayed by Benzinga at 10:01 ET: 'adjusted earnings per share of $0.45, which was below the expected $0.61 ... management slashed the company's full-year 2026 earnings outlook'.
The results were public before the open. Benzinga carried the CEO's conference-call remarks at 07:44 ET: 'Mexico Demand As Weak As I've Seen In Years', and the call transcript at 08:34 ET.
Move: SW 40.30 vs Tuesday's 42.59 close, -5.38% on 32,930 IEX shares, range 40.13-40.98 in the first half hour. The market has priced the miss and the cut, and the 10:01 item is a recap.
objections: Late by over two hours and through the open; -5.4% already.
